sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Sierra Savage is listed as a reserve officer in the August and September 2026 American Fork Police Department directories. American Fork City compensation records list her as a Records Specialist in fiscal year 2022 and as a Police Officer I from fiscal years 2023 through 2026.
